Build locally with Packer; other backends refuse execution

Usage:
  imago build [flags]

Flags:
  -b, --backend string      Build backend (local, gitea, proxmox, gitlab, woodpecker, harbor, minio, jenkins, github) (default "local")
      --dry-run             Validate a build plan without execution
  -f, --flavor string       Flavor to build (default "base-generic")
  -h, --help                help for build
      --output-dir string   Artifact directory (logs in logs/) (default "./output-images")
      --packer-dir string   Packer template directory (default "./packer")
      --versions string     Manifest with build toolchain pins (default "versions.json")
